checks: Repeated debug/release, finite oracles and compiled production control; see model.md#evidence.
cost: For B JSON bytes, V synsets, E hypernym edges, S sense references and maximum per-synset hypernym/member lengths H/M, a conservative load bound is O(B+(V+E+S)log V+S*(H log V+M)), ignoring string widths. Ancestry is O((V+E)log V+40E) for reached graph, memory O(V+E); the output cap does not cap graph work when many labels duplicate. No timing claim.
description: WordNet JSON snapshot projection, lexical candidates and bounded ancestry.
forward: load sorts JSON paths and builds synsets plus lemma/POS entries, then projects senses and up links. Public wordnet lazily caches either the loaded maps or empty fallback forever. Queries derive lowercase candidate forms and use POS-specific senses; ancestry follows synset IDs breadth-first and emits at most 40 distinct first-member labels.
inverse: Behavior complement first: inner excluded relation under fixed declared scope.
Reverse reconstruction second: all compatible antecedents, generally nonunique.
limitations: Partial syntax only; no semantic AST or general correctness proof.
No live global dictionary, parser, teacher, corpus, GPU or full-school evidence.
state: Sorted supplied JSON files, owned WordNet maps, process OnceLock snapshot, suffix/stem dependency and query strings.
